name: Trickplayer
description: Plex/Jellyfin player as synced thumbnails + subs

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to Plex to sign in, and to your own Plex or Jellyfin server (plex.direct or tailscale ts.net) to download trick-play frames and subtitles.

notes: Episodes now open on their own page, with the episode's picture, description, and season and episode number. Stop is now Back.
Episodes without subtitles can get some: Find subtitles searches through your media server, which downloads the one you pick.
For episodes with subtitles inside the video, you choose: extract them, or download some instead. Extraction shows how long is left and can be cancelled.
While an episode loads, the glasses show its title, what's happening and a progress bar.
The episode list keeps its place when you go back.
Fixed the phone preview skipping some subtitle lines.
